subject: Common phrases and features for statements
notes: Phrase rule 3: 'After completion of the arithmetic operations, and possibly the storing of values ..., control is transferred to the imperative-statement specified in the SIZE ERROR phrase' (--check 14.7.5 -> OK §14.7.5 3)). PROBE p1.cob E9/E10 display the receivers FROM INSIDE the phrase and see the non-erring receivers already stored (051 / 117), so the dispatch follows all stores; the statement then ends (next DISPLAY runs once). Row text also carries the lead-in 'If the size error condition exists and a SIZE ERROR phrase is not specified:' which introduces L3.x, adjudicated there. Also conformance:cases/14.9.2-ADD/optional_on_size_error. || editions as adjudicated: 1985, 2002, 2014, 2023
